description: This Java source file defines the AddFileActivity class, an Android activity responsible for creating files with specified names and sizes, supporting different storage options (internal, external, donotbackup), and handling user input and intent parameters.

classes.name: AddFileActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for creating files with user-specified or intent-specified parameters, supporting different storage options, and providing user feedback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and initializes spinners for file size and storage options.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks for intent extras to create a file immediately if parameters are provided; validates parameters and storage availability.

methods.name: onCreateFileButtonClick
methods.description: Handles user action to create a file based on input fields, validates input, and initiates file creation.

methods.name: initFileSizeSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the spinner for selecting file size multipliers.

methods.name: initFileStorageSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the spinner for selecting file storage options.

methods.name: createFileWithRandomDataAndFinishActivity
methods.description: Creates a file with random byte data of specified size in the selected storage location, shows a toast, and sets activity result.

methods.name: isFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file with the given name already exists in internal storage.

methods.name: isSizeValid
methods.description: Validates that the size parameter is a non-negative number.

methods.name: isFileStorageParamValid
methods.description: Validates the file storage parameter and updates the storage enum accordingly.

methods.name: getInternalFile
methods.description: Returns a File object in the internal storage directory with the given filename.
